messages:
TJ - Sales: Heads up — ACME Health wants a 4-week POC to validate our inference for clinical note summarization. They asked for DPA, SOC2 evidence, BAA/hipaa scope, and an outline of acceptance criteria + pricing. Can SE/security/legal chime in?
Maria (SE): Thanks TJ. Quick Qs: which model family do they want to test (open or redwood-verified)? and will they feed PHI into the service?
TJ - Sales: They plan to use our hosted API but with redacted PHI tokens initially. Customer requested a path to test with real PHI under a BAA if we can provide one. They prefer an LLM comparable to Llama2-70B or a Redwood-optimized variant. Timeline: start in 2 weeks, 4 week duration.
Karen (Security): We can share SOC 2 Type II report and our standard DPA. For HIPAA/BAA: we have a templated BAA but need legal review from ACME. Important: if they send PHI to hosted, we need to enable dedicated tenancy or Private deployment per policy.
Oliver (Legal): Confirming — we can provide the BAA template. For hosted POC with PHI there are extra contractual requirements (audits, e-sign). If they only send de-identified data we can do standard DPA. Who is the customer's legal contact?
TJ - Sales: Customer legal is lisa.m@acmehealth.com — will loop her in after we align scope.
Maria (SE): Proposed POC acceptance criteria (draft):
- Quality: ROUGE-L / semantic similarity on 200 labeled test prompts: baseline >= 0.72 vs their golden summaries.
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for 512-token requests with burst up to 30 qps.
- Safety: 0 allowed PHI leakage incidents in 1k randomly sampled outputs; log-based evidence.
- Cost: infer cost <= $0.018/token (TBD) or total compute spend cap $X for POC.
TJ - Sales: Can we give a firm number for compute cap or discount? ACME asked for pricing for a 4-week evaluation box.
Alex S.: For hosted POC we can offer a discounted reservation: 40% off list for the POC if they commit to a billed cap (e.g., $25k for 4 weeks). If they go Private/Dedicated costs will be different. I'll draft a sample quote.
Karen (Security): Pen-test ask: ACME requested prior vendor pen-test reports and the option to run a customer-led penetration test in a staging VPC. We have a process: provide SOC artifacts, sign NDA, schedule a window in our private deployment or a dedicated staging cluster. Customer-run pentest on hosted infra is not permitted; must be in isolated env. Also note additional cost/time for staging prep.
Maria (SE): Technical checklist for POC (quick):
- Eval dataset (200 samples) + expected outputs (golden).
- API keys + test account provisioning.
- Redaction plan & sync on PHI fields.
- Logging + retention window (we can restrict to 7 days).
- Telemetry hooks for latency/tracing.
Snippet for redaction pipeline we recommend:
```
# pre-send redaction (example)
input = redact_phi(raw_text)
resp = client.generate(model="rw-70b-opt", prompt=input, max_tokens=512)
output = postprocess(resp)
```
TJ - Sales: Great — Maria can you prepare the eval harness and acceptance test plan by EOD Friday? Karen/legal can we have SOC/DPA/BAA packaged to send to ACME by Friday too?
Oliver (Legal): Yes — we'll prepare the BAA and flag any non-standard clauses. Need ACME legal contact and any regulator specifics (state-level)?
Karen (Security): I'll attach a short checklist for their security team: SOC2 summary, pen-test summary (redacted), encryption & key management notes, network segmentation for Private deploy, and required logs. Also we can propose a 2-hour security review call.
Alex S.: One more operational note: for PHI tests in Private, we recommend disabling persistent KV caching and enabling strict request-level redaction logging. I'll include the config snippet in the harness.
TJ - Sales: Perfect. I'll loop in ACME (lisa.m) after docs are ready. Next internal sync tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Reminder — prep-demo environment scheduled for 2026-05-12 14:00 UTC (provisioning in progress).
Maria (SE): I'll start building the eval harness and post the invite for the 10am sync.
Karen (Security): I'll compile SOC/DPA and coordinate the pen-test staging notes with infra.
Oliver (Legal): Drafting BAA now, will share the editable doc in this thread.
